note: OPERATION XXV-2 (#166). The designated live-reference-solver and git-history no-tune test files. The science workflow runs exactly these and FAILS (check_junit.py --manifest) on any skip, on a testcase not from these files, on a designated file with no executed testcase, on a duplicate (classname, name), or if fewer than expected_executed tests ran. sandbox_expected_executed is the floor for the whole experiments/sandbox_foundation/tests run (measured 2026-11-08 with pytest --collect-only -q: 1463 collected). Raise a count only when tests are added, in the same commit; a PR that lowers a count or drops a file FAILS (manifest_guard.py) unless science/MANIFEST_CHANGE_JUSTIFICATION.md is updated in that PR and names each drop verbatim.
